Description: Regulates which PyPSA-Eur bus carriers are kept when importing the electricity snapshot into the sector model. Defaults to keeping only the AC transmission bus.
Regulates which PyPSA-Eur link carriers (such as HVDC interconnectors) are kept when importing the snapshot.
Controls which generator carriers from the PyPSA-Eur snapshot are retained (others are removed) before sector coupling. Nuclear not included in this list for the Walloon workflow.
Controls which StorageUnit carriers are retained; other PyPSA-Eur storage units are dropped because they are modelled differently in the sector workflow.
Controls which store carriers are retained; most store components are removed because the sector workflow implements them separately.
